note: Manual audit of the 21,350-observation production plan against the merged code. PASS needs a named test or an inspected location; FAIL is a verified engineering gap or mismatch; BLOCKED needs a researcher decision, authorization, hardware or a measurement; NOT_RUN was not executed. Nothing here approves a gate. E7a update (2026-10-23): the supervisor and the K18 diagnostic findings are resolved for bounded fixtures; production launch stays unimplemented. E7a review update: independent multi-lens review of the supervisor, K18 diagnostics, training proposal and documentation; the material findings are fixed with regression tests (P30 section 9). Items touched by E7a cite line numbers at the E7a head; untouched items cite 755b474. Main moved to 5d3f1a3 when PR #21 (the first, pre-review E7a state) was merged; this round is its follow-up. The audit base for items not touched by E7a stays 755b474. Main is now 0e8c467 (PR #22 merged the review hardening); a post-merge audit and its fixes are in the hotfix that follows.

items.title: Existing CLIs cover all three production stages
items.message: geosim.b2_dataset (--roles, --limit-groups, --groups-per-shard, --cancellation, --config), geosim.b2_test_dataset and geosim.b2_matched_dataset (--known) exist with the flags the E5 plan names; no unrestricted launcher is supplied and none was run.
items.verified_by: inspection: argparse definitions read at the cited lines

items.title: The plan's four groups per shard is not the generators' default (eight)
items.message: All three generators default GROUPS_PER_SHARD to 8, which would double the interruption loss (64/40/24 observations). The value is part of the request, so it cannot drift silently; `audit --production` rejects any root whose request is not the frozen production request.

items.title: Cross-stage source, config and known-root binding is enforced before use
items.message: The test-only and matched generators bind the known root's fingerprints and calibration but not its generator source hashes, so a stage built from different code still verifies on its own. The preflight audit with --known flags source, numpy/scipy, config and canceller drift between stages.

items.title: An interrupted known root resumes without rewriting verified shards
items.message: A kill between shards leaves a RESUMABLE root; the generator keeps committed shards byte-identical and the final arrays equal an uninterrupted run. Loss per interruption is bounded by one shard.

items.title: A kill between the data-file renames and the descriptor commit fails closed
items.message: Data files without a committed descriptor make the generator refuse the root (unverified partial shard). This is safe but not automatic: the audit reports NEEDS_QUARANTINE and recovery is a manual move of the orphan files to a quarantine directory (never deletion), after which the resume is bit-equal. An unattended supervisor must implement that runbook (see audit.stage_supervisor_missing).

items.title: Modified shards, metadata and calibration are detected before use
items.message: Checksum depth reads every committed shard and fails on a single flipped byte; the cheap structure depth cannot see byte flips and is labelled as such. Deep depth additionally runs the generator's own semantic validator on a bounded sample. Manifest-level and root-level tampering is checked with the generators' own `_header` and exercised on all three stages.

items.title: An immutable source/config/environment lock can be created and verified
items.message: The lock hashes every src/**/*.py and the bundled curves, the frozen configs, the gates file and the generator provenance, and records the git commit, tree cleanliness, Python/NumPy/SciPy versions and BLAS thread settings. Any drift is named; edited lock files fail their own fingerprint.

items.title: A manifest's recorded git commit is not evidence of an unmodified source tree
items.message: The generators record `git rev-parse HEAD` without a dirty flag ("unknown" when git fails), and the request hashes only src/geosim/*.py and its data, not src/geoml or the configs. The lock covers the whole source tree and configs and can require a clean tree.

items.title: Role/group isolation is checked on every committed shard
items.message: Group ids are checked against the frozen reserved ranges and for repetition across shards and roles; a request whose test role holds training groups, or a descriptor with a foreign group, is INVALID.

items.title: The streaming trainer refuses wrong-role and test-only sources
items.message: fit_streaming requires known-kind sources of the train and val-select roles and disjoint scenario groups (E1 evidence, unchanged by E6).

items.title: Streaming reads verify shards and fail closed on missing or damaged ones
items.message: Verification of 384-observation-per-role fixtures ran at about 430 observations/s (E1 note); this is a bounded-fixture measurement, not a production-size one (see audit.streaming_unmeasured_at_scale).

items.title: Raw IQ is transient; artifacts hold spec, mask, residual and index arrays only
items.message: The generator drops the IQ after the canceller and the reader rejects unexpected array keys. Consequence: the fifth channel exists only because it was computed at generation time, so a new receiver version needs regeneration of every residual-bearing stage.

items.title: A path/length/SHA-256 transfer manifest can be created and verified after a copy
items.message: Implements E5 plan step 5: missing, extra, resized and modified files are named; a restored backup must still be re-audited shard by shard before training.

items.title: No frozen production training configuration exists; a candidate specification awaits researcher decisions
items.message: E7a prepared a reviewable candidate (docs/plan/B2_E7_TRAINING_SPEC_PROPOSAL.md, b2_e7_training_proposal.json: 29 parameter records, ten numbered decisions R1-R10, measured/analytic footprint). It is explicitly not frozen and not approved; width, epochs, batch, optimizer/scheduler, seeds, window, interruption and test-coupling policy need the researcher before a production config can be committed, any value other than the P6 / TrainConfig default (and any data-driven epoch sizing) is a change to P18 section 5 ('P6 settings, no search') that needs a P18 section 10 entry, and R10 asks to confirm the acceptance 0.95 / Pfa 0.05 / Mahalanobis 0.1 constants that P20 and the pilot config state but P18 does not. configs/b2_feat.json remains the 3-epoch pilot.

items.title: The train-only center/CE ratio diagnostic is recorded by both trainers and in the result JSON
items.message: geoml.train.fit and geoml.b2_stream.fit_streaming return an additive train_diagnostics block (B2-train-diagnostics/1: per-epoch mean CE, weighted/unweighted center term, weighted/unweighted plan BCE, center/CE ratio with counts and an unavailable reason, embedding rms, provenance; observation_only, affects_training=false, split=train). b2_experiment and b2_loko now write it next to history, together with best_epoch and best_val_macro_f1 so a reader of the summary can pick the evaluated checkpoint's epoch out of the block. Bit-identity with origin/main 755b474 (goldens, verbatim original loops, gradients, RNG) is tested on CPU fp32 (torch 2.14.1, 1/2/4 threads; an independent review compared 268 configurations without a mismatch); GPU parity is not tested here and belongs to the bounded DR-05 probe. Editing train.py, b2_stream.py, b2_experiment.py and b2_loko.py changes their hashes in checkpoint provenance (P28 section 6); earlier checkpoints are not relabelled. K18 itself stays PENDING_RESEARCHER; this is a diagnostic only.

items.title: A fail-closed staged supervisor exists (bounded fixtures only; the production launch is not implemented)
items.message: scripts/b2_production_supervisor.py (P30) runs known, test-only and matched in order as supervised children: dry run by default, immutable lock re-verified before every stage and attempt, relocatable run identity (plan, ceilings, timing, heartbeat and launcher), hash-chained journal anchored by journal.head with a tail check on every append, wait4 exit codes/CPU, monotonic elapsed time, polled child RSS (ru_maxrss kept as an upper bound), heartbeats and an estimated charge for a lost supervisor, wall/CPU/RSS/failed-attempt/interruption/disk ceilings (fixtures and production plans cannot raise them), first-shard timing gate, SIGINT/SIGTERM handling, the process group emptied after every attempt, a child that dies with the supervisor, an unreadable host probe failing closed, orphan quarantine (never deletes), and completion only for the exact planned inventory produced under the plan by a clean supervised attempt. Every spawned command must carry --limit-groups 1..2; production execution is always refused. Exercised by 162 tests (a second, post-merge audit added 35) (stand-in children under the real generator CLIs, a mutation pass in which all but two equivalent mutants are killed) and by a capped real-physics run (two groups per stage, interrupted once, supervisor SIGKILLed once, resumed to completion).

items.title: Full LOKO execution and multi-seed aggregation are not implemented
items.message: geoml.b2_loko plans all folds but executes exactly one view, one fold on CPU under epoch/width/batch caps. Not needed to generate data; needed before DR-E5-06 could be exercised.

items.title: Interrupted training cannot resume; restart-versus-snapshot policy is undecided
items.message: A checkpoint stores model weights (best epoch) only, not optimizer, scheduler, RNG or the data cursor. Either a separately reviewed snapshot is built, or an interrupted seed/view restarts from epoch 0 with the parent checkpoint hash recorded. That is a policy decision before GPU use.

items.title: Streaming memory and throughput are unmeasured at production size
items.message: E1 fixtures hold at most 384 observations per role; the production train role holds 12,000. The window-memory arithmetic is verified (12.06 MiB raw and 20.0 MiB preprocessed per 32-observation shard) but peak memory and per-epoch I/O at scale need the authorized data or a separately approved synthetic-layout fixture.

items.title: Generation wall time is an extrapolation from a 60-observation matched profile
items.message: 23.0-30.2 h reproduces arithmetically from 3.8-5.0 s/observation, but the known stage's group mix differs from the matched profile and nothing was timed beyond 64 observations. A start-up gate that compares the first committed shards with the band (stop if outside) belongs to the authorized run, not to this preflight. E7a's capped real-physics run (this sandbox, two groups per stage, clean tree) cost 4.67 s/observation for the known stage (64 observations, three attempts including the restarts and the estimated charge of one lost attempt), 5.25 for test-only (10) and 4.76 for matched (6) as whole-attempt wall per observation including start-up; the first-shard gate figures (3.1-4.5 s/observation) subtract a fixed 6 s allowance from 3-8 observation shards and are not per-observation costs, so they neither confirm nor refute the 3.8-5.0 band for any stage. Nothing was timed at production size.

items.title: Production host, GPU and backup target are not designated
items.message: The E5 numbers (36 h wall, 42 core-h, 25 GiB working disk, a separate 9 GB backup, 8/16 GiB host RAM, 8-12 GiB VRAM) are proposals. No host, GPU or backup location has been named or authorized, so host probes can only prove an unrelated machine unsuitable.

items.title: GitHub Actions on this post-merge hotfix pull-request head
items.message: Recorded in the draft PR description after publication; CI for any other head, including the merged E5, E6 and E7a heads, does not certify it.

items.title: Supervisor verified end to end with real physics on a two-group-per-stage fixture
items.message: Real generators (obs-cancel/1), 80 observations in total, clean tree at commit bda3151 (the hotfix code; the PR #22 code was verified the same way at dd5d965): the dry run created nothing (exit 4); SIGINT after the first known shard gave exit 6 with a resumable root, verify exit 5 and a refused completion (exit 3); the supervisor was then SIGKILLed mid-attempt (its child died with it), the next start recorded supervisor_lost with an estimated charge, and the third start finished all stages; verify exit 0 and completion.json (scope fixture, production_complete=false, benchmark_complete=false, supervisor/preflight SHA-256 recorded). Child peak RSS 506-592 MiB (polled VmHWM); five attempts, wall 380 s, CPU 449 s, the lost attempt's share estimated. The raw journal (112 records) is committed and verifies with Journal.load.

items.title: The unbounded production launch is not implemented
items.message: By design (PRODUCTION_LAUNCH_ENABLED is False; every child needs --limit-groups 1..2). Enabling it is a later, separately authorized and reviewed milestone that needs: the four approved gates, a production-size first-shard timing validation on the designated host, and a review of the unbounded command builder.

items.title: The compute budget assumes width 8 but the trainer defaults to width 16
items.message: The 200-1000 samples/s band and the 6 GPU-h reservation were written for the width-8 pilot network; TrainConfig and P6 default to width 16 (about 3.3x the multiply-accumulates; K18 D/2 ratio 128 instead of 64). The width is researcher decision R2; the budget must be recomputed for the chosen width.

items.title: The experiment runner trains and evaluates the test role in one invocation
items.message: E5 plan step 7 asks for all nine models to be frozen before any test evaluation; geoml.b2_experiment has no train-only mode and one seed per invocation. Either a procedural freeze or a reviewed train-only mode is needed (researcher decision R8).

items.title: The training data loader is synchronous
items.message: No DataLoader, prefetch or workers exist. At the E1 rates the train-read and preprocessing path alone is roughly 39 minutes per 30-epoch fit (about 5.9 h for nine fits); the estimate omits the val-select read and preprocessing and the K17b re-preprocessing, which bring it to about 47 minutes per fit and 7.0 h for nine (roughly 1.9x the whole 6 GPU-h reservation); unverified on the target host. The authorized GPU probe must measure end to end.
